t: What Does The Name Beight Mean?
s: As a topographic name, it may connect to bight, meaning a bend in a coast or river, marking someone who lived near a bay or river-loop; alternatively, it can reflect assimilation to Bright (Old English beorht, “bright, splendid”), a well-attested surname and given name element in Anglo-Saxon compounds. Phonetic drift and regional orthography in early modern records likely produced Beight alongside Beightt, Beighton (a locational surname from Derbyshire and South Yorkshire), and the cognate forms Bight and Bite.
